entries.zh: 收殓；为死者装裹入棺（殡殓之礼）
entries.en: to shroud a corpse; to lay out the dead for burial
entries.notes: 汉字“脩”当为“收”之借字，收殓（siu-liām）即殡殓，与 amortajar 相合。

entries.en: to wrap, to wrap up (a body in a shroud)

entries.zh: 浅腹，心胸狭窄、易恼易怒
entries.en: irritable, quick to take offence; petty-minded (lit. “shallow belly”)
entries.notes: 西语词头疑为 amostazado（动怒）之讹，“浅腹”即心胸窄小、易恼。

entries.en: to disturb, to stir up; to rouse (to disorder)
entries.notes: 汉字疑为“扰”之讹写（jiáu），西语 amotinar 为煽乱、搅扰之义。

entries.en: to riot, to raise a disturbance; to stir up trouble
entries.notes: 汉字“樛”当为“扰”，扰乱（jiáu-loān）与 amotinar 吻合。

entries.zh: 怙，依靠、倚托（受扶持庇护）
entries.en: to rely on, to lean on; to be sustained and sheltered
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（怙/忖）；怙匣母俗读 kōo，与 M/R 相合，义为倚靠受扶持。

entries.en: to look after, to take care of; to attend to

entries.zh: 顾盼，时时看顾、留意照看
entries.en: to watch over, to keep an eye on; to look after
entries.notes: “盼/眄”两读皆可通，义为看顾、留意照看。

entries.en: to depend on, to rely on (for protection)
to explain, to expound; to make clear (Sp. encaminar, to set on the road)
entries.notes: 西语 encaminar（引路上道）与“解释”义有张力，汉字与音写一致作解释。

entries.zh: 作主，做主、当东家（为人出头、担保）
entries.en: to act as master/patron; to take charge, to stand for someone

entries.zh: 福荫，庇佑、荫庇（受福泽庇护）
entries.en: protection and blessing; to be under (ancestral) blessing and shade
entries.notes: 西语 serbo 疑为 serviçio/servir 之省文，与“福荫”（庇佑）义合。

entries.zh: 受荫，蒙受庇荫、得人庇护
entries.en: to receive protection; to come under someone's shade

entries.zh: 遮荫，遮蔽、挡荫（为人遮护）
entries.en: to shade, to screen; to cover over so as to shelter

entries.zh: 遮拦，拦挡、遮护（以身挡在前面）
entries.en: to block, to bar the way; to shield by stepping in front
entries.notes: 汉字疑作“拦”，义为拦挡遮护，与西语“以身居中挡在面前”相合。
音写、汉字、官话三栏皆空，仅存西语栏残字 Janglian.，无从定夺。
